chapter_seo_title: The Destruction of the Otherworld – A Victory Earned in Blood and Fire
chapter_meta_description: The allied supreme beings destroy the Otherworld, but the victory is incomplete. The Ancestral Dragon Ship returns with only corpses, and deeper threats remain hidden.
og_title: The Destruction of the Otherworld – A Hollow Victory
og_description: Pangu, Fuxi, and Wu Zu combine to annihilate the Otherworld. Yet the four founding ancestors escape, and the Ancestral Dragon Ship returns empty with all aboard dead.
